wc.note: Developer 1.24 m2 is CLEAR floor with the riser короб excluded; the measured 1.6-1.9 m2 are GROSS to the wall faces. See measurement_conventions - the room is the same size.

living_kitchen.note: Developer figure is living 19.49 + kitchen 5.24; the measured plans record the pair as one room, so they are only comparable summed.

tolerance_summary.guidance: Wall-to-wall dimensions of the same nominal wall differ by 0-50 mm between flats (median 20 mm). Treat any dimension in the model as nominal +/- 25 mm, and never design a fit that depends on less than about 30 mm of slack.
tolerance_summary.area_guidance: Room areas agree within 0.1-0.3 m2 across the comparables; the totals differ by up to 2.4 m2 (68.3 to 70.7) and that is dominated by how the loggia is counted, not by the rooms.
tolerance_summary.biggest_outlier: RESOLVED. The туалет difference is a clear-vs-gross convention (developer deducts the вентблок, measured plans do not): 1140 x 1090 clear + 1140 x 490 вентблок = 1.80 m2, which two of three measured flats print. kv109's smaller 1.6 m2 is a floor effect - flats above the 10th floor carry a second ventilation section. This flat is on the 4th floor, so the single-section geometry and the larger areas apply.
tolerance_summary.use_which_comparables: kv53 and Минина 6 for this flat. kv109 is a different sub-type; keep it as evidence of the floor effect, not as a sample of the expected size.

caveats: The comparables are as-built plans of other flats in the same series, not of this flat.

measurement_conventions.developer_plan: clear (net) floor area, service boxing deducted
measurement_conventions.measured_bti_plans: gross floor area to wall faces, boxing counted as floor
measurement_conventions.rule: Never compare a developer area with a measured area directly. Where they differ by roughly the footprint of a service короб, that is the explanation before any construction difference is.
measurement_conventions.affects: туалет most (0.56 m2 of a 1.8 m2 room), ванная a little (~0.15), прихожая a little (~0.3). Living rooms have no risers and agree within 0.1.

wc_resolution.question: туалет reads 1.24 m2 on the developer plan and 1.6-1.9 m2 on every measured plan.
wc_resolution.answer: Different conventions, not different rooms. The developer publishes the CLEAR floor area with the стояки boxed out; the measured (БТИ-style) plans publish the GROSS area to the wall faces, counting the короб as floor.
wc_resolution.conclusion: 1140 x 1090 = 1.24 clear, plus the 1140 x 490 recess = 1.80 - which lands on the 1.8 and 1.9 of two of the three measured flats. The usable floor really is about 1.24 m2.
services_in_that_corner: вентблок с каналами (в туалете) - three channels drawn in section
стояки водоснабжения и канализации are also in the wet zone, position not yet pinpointed on the plan
wc_resolution.attribution: Explanation from the apartment owner; the arithmetic above is the check, and it agrees.
wc_resolution.consequence: Plan the туалет against ~1.24 m2 of usable floor, not 1.8. The короб is not removable - the стояки are common property and serve the whole riser.
wc_resolution.open_question: kv109 reads 1.6 m2, which is 0.2 below the other two. Either a smaller recess or a different sub-type; unresolved.
wc_resolution.correction_2026_08_26: The 1140 x 490 recess in the туалет is the ВЕНТБЛОК, not the plumbing короб. Zooming into the developer's plan shows a grey block with three rounded channels in section - the ventilation shaft with its satellite ducts - and not the circles that would draw water risers. The area arithmetic is unaffected (1.24 clear + 0.56 = 1.80 gross); what changes is which service is responsible.

floor_dependency.statement: Flats above the 10th floor carry TWO ventilation sections where the lower floors carry one - in the туалет and again between the kitchen zone and the laundry/hallway zone. The second section takes additional floor area.
floor_dependency.this_flat: 4th floor - one section, so the larger of the observed areas applies
floor_dependency.explains: kv109 printing туалет 1.6 m2 and a 68.3 m2 total against kv53's 1.9 and 70.7: consistent with kv109 being a higher-floor flat with the doubled vent block.
floor_dependency.confidence: owner's account, consistent with the measured spread; not independently verified against a section drawing
floor_dependency.plumbing_note: The plumbing riser zone is identical in every flat per the owner - only ventilation varies with floor.

wc_resolution.precision_caveat_2026_08_26: The 1.24 m2 used in the arithmetic is the DETAILED plan's figure. The developer's BASIC plan - the one actually traced in Homestyler - prints 1.42 m2 for the same туалет. With 1.42 the clear-plus-вентблок sum is 1.98 rather than 1.80, so the match to the measured 1.8/1.9 is suggestive rather than exact. The conclusion stands qualitatively: the measured plans count the вентблок zone and the usable floor is roughly 1.2-1.4 m2. The exact figure does not.

registration.purpose: Transform between the raster plans and CAD millimetres, so the images can be used as tracing surfaces.

basic_plan.note: Worse fit, but the residual is a thin fringe along every wall - a scale/offset error, not a geometric difference. The basic plan is a smaller, simpler drawing and registers less precisely.

registration.use: Register against the DETAILED plan even though the BASIC plan was the tracing base in Homestyler: it is the more accurate target and the two describe the same flat.
